ui.auto_evidence_hint: Records a narrated video for every changed or new page after each compare run, instead of requiring a manual click.
ui.auto_recording_hint: Records a plain, un-annotated video for every unchanged page after each compare run - the only way to get a video for a passing dynamic test.

ui.stale_pages: saved page(s) are no longer in the current sitemap. Save the set to remove them.
ui.steps_hint: A JSON array of steps. Each step is {"type":"navigate","url":...}, {"type":"click","selector":...} (or "text" to click by visible text) or {"type":"fill","selector":...,"value":...}. Add "checkpoint": true to capture and compare a screenshot at that step, "before_seconds": 1 to pause before a step, "delay_seconds": 3 to pause after a step, "outline_seconds" / "glide_seconds" to size a click's outline and cursor glide in the recording, and "value_env": "ADMIN_PASSWORD" to read a value from the project's own .env file instead of storing it here.

ui.base_url_hint: ReeQA reads sitemap.xml and captures pages from this URL.
